$comment: Community-maintained catalog of AI agents, MCP servers, and agent harnesses. Public domain (CC0) — see catalog/LICENSE. Consulted ONLY for components that structured parsing could not identify (no bundleId, no publisher, no declaredCapabilities). A `match` block matches when every non-null field it lists matches the component: pathContains is a case-insensitive substring test on the resolved path; bundleId and nameExact are exact (case-insensitive) equality. No match means the component stays unidentified; entries never guess.
